en.abdullah-al-shahin: (24) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from Muhammad bin al-Mufadhdhal bin Ibraheem from Muhammad bin Abdullah bin Zurara from al-Harith bin al-Mugheera and Thurayh al-Muharibi that Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) had said: “
Nothing remains between us and the Arabs except slaughter. (He pointed with his hand at his mouth).”
